top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a new class of quantum matter: Kane and Mele's quantum spin Hall state and Z2 invariant, with Molenkamp's HgTe realisation, a short prediction-to-observation chain confirmed independently for about two decades. It is more mature than twisted bilayer graphene and a conceptual advance rather than an instrument advance. The citation must be limited to the 2D prediction plus first realisation, since the 3D branch (Fu, Moore, Balents, Hasan) and HgTe proposers (Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang) are left out. P002 is the defensible fallback with clean credit; P003 is not yet mature; no award is worse than any of the three.
